name: Vajra-30
tagline: 30kg Heavyweight Arena Combat Titan with High-Kinetic Weapon Drum
imageAlt: Vajra-30 Heavyweight Combat Battlebot Prototype Chassis
description: Machined from aerospace-grade alloy billets and enclosed in welded 6mm Hardox 500 armor. Vajra-30 is designed to withstand violent pneumatic flips and catastrophic disc strikes while delivering 18.5 kJ kinetic energy blows.

specs.controller: Dual 2.4GHz FHSS with hardware optical kill switch

keyFeatures: Stores 18.5 kJ kinetic energy in high-speed spinning mass
Continuous Hardox 500 unibody armor plate weldments
Dual-receiver fail-safe with 5ms link loss cut-off
Custom urethane drive wheels with high-traction tread
architectureSummary: The drivetrain combines dual 750W brushless hub motors geared down to deliver explosive pushing torque. The weapon sub-assembly utilizes a balanced asymmetric drum supported by sealed ceramic angular-contact bearings to absorb direct radial shocks.

name: Apex-Rover v3
tagline: Autonomous Mobile Robot with 3D LiDAR SLAM & Neural Edge Vision
imageAlt: Apex-Rover v3 Autonomous Mobile Robot with LiDAR Navigation
featuredAward: Best Autonomous Navigation Architecture (National Robotics Summit)
description: Engineered for industrial warehouse transport and GPS-denied indoor mapping. Apex-Rover v3 continuously builds dense 3D point-clouds, maps unknown floor plans, and avoids dynamic human obstacles in real time.

specs.power: 24V 20Ah LiFePO4 battery pack with active smart BMS
specs.controller: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (40 TOPS) + STM32 RTOS core
specs.actuatorsOrWeapon: Dual planetary brushless hub drives + active suspension
specs.chassisMaterial: Laser-cut 5052 aluminum internal skeleton + carbon panels

keyFeatures: Real-time 3D RTAB-Map SLAM running locally on ROS2 Humble
Dynamic obstacle avoidance latency under 35 milliseconds
Hot-swappable battery dock with battery balancing telemetry
architectureSummary: High-level perception runs on Jetson Orin Nano using TensorRT accelerated YOLOv8 object detection. Odometry is computed through dual magnetic wheel encoders fused with an industrial 9-axis IMU via an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF).

name: KRS Agastya
tagline: University Rover Challenge (URC) Planetary Explorer with 6-DOF Manipulator
imageAlt: KRS Agastya Planetary Mars Rover Prototype
featuredAward: Outstanding System Engineering & Arm Kinematics (URC Regional Selection)
description: KRS Agastya features an advanced 6-wheel rocker-bogie suspension designed to traverse 45-degree rock scree slopes and extreme desert terrain without chassis tipping.

specs.controller: Custom STM32H7 Dual-Core Master + Raspberry Pi 5 Node
specs.actuatorsOrWeapon: 6-DOF Harmonic Drive Manipulator Arm with interchangeable end-effector
specs.chassisMaterial: Continuous carbon fiber square tubing + titanium hinge pins

keyFeatures: Interchangeable soil auger drill with micro-spectrometry module
Real-time inverse kinematics solver running on embedded ROS2
architectureSummary: The arm kinematics utilize cycloidal speed reducers machined in-house for zero backlash. A custom CAN bus network links all 6 joint driver nodes back to the central STM32H7 processor.

name: Garuda-UAV X
tagline: Autonomous Search & Rescue Drone with Optical Flow & Thermal Payload
imageAlt: Garuda-UAV X Autonomous Search and Rescue Drone Prototype
description: Carbon unibody quadplane drone engineered for beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) emergency medicine delivery and thermal survivor tracking.

specs.power: 6S 10,000mAh Semi-Solid State Li-Ion pack (42 min flight time)
specs.controller: Pixhawk 6X Pro Autopilot running PX4 + Raspberry Pi CM4
specs.actuatorsOrWeapon: T-Motor U8 High-Efficiency Brushless with 18-inch folding carbon props
specs.chassisMaterial: 3K Twill Carbon fiber monocoque plate with CNC alloy motor mounts

keyFeatures: 42-minute endurance under real-world 12 m/s headwind conditions
Down-facing optical flow sensor for GPS-denied indoor hovering
Dual-sensor FLIR thermal + 4K EO gimbal payload with edge object tracking
Pneumatic cargo release mechanism for precision medical airdrops
architectureSummary: Garuda-UAV X integrates PX4 autopilot with companion onboard compute running companion MAVLink telemetry. Failsafe return-to-launch (RTL) triggers automatically on battery drop or radio signal degradation.
